cases.title: Buzz model download handles offline failure, reconnect and retry without false success
cases.notes: Offline mid-download (QMP set_link net0 down): enp0s3 NO-CARRIER, download froze at 12%/0.6GB, 9337 did not serve the model (GEMMA_LISTED=0) - no false success. After reconnect (net0 up) the download resumed to 78% and completed; model served on loopback 9337; inference returned UMBRA_AI_OK. Full recovery.

cases.title: Low disk, cancelled Buzz model download and changed upstream metadata fail safely
cases.notes: AI-03 (a) BIOS-lane cancel/offline/lowdisk gate A32_BUZZ_FAILURE_PATHS_PASS (other agent). (b) UEFI-encrypted lowdisk: disk filled to 1.6G, download froze at 27% with NO served model (GEMMA_LISTED=0, blob .incomplete) - no false success; after freeing disk, model re-downloaded (8.09GB layers) and inference returned UMBRA_AI_OK. No injection produced a false success.

cases.title: Virtual and software renderer states are measured and reported honestly
cases.notes: virtio-vga VM measured honestly as software rendering in both live and installed sessions: glxinfo -B via Xwayland shows Device llvmpipe (LLVM 21.1.8), Accelerated: no, Mesa 26.1.5. shadowfetch-health --json runs clean (summary fail=0) with no hardware-acceleration claim; it has no renderer-specific check so the honest state is the glxinfo record plus a health run that neither fails nor misreports. This case's subject is the virtual/software path itself - VM evidence is the correct class here.

cases.title: NVIDIA new-generation driver workflow and rollback path validate
cases.notes: NVIDIA new-generation driver workflow validated on 81a90678. Physical-hardware half (rel3 VFIO passthrough of the founder RTX 5060 Ti): guest saw the GB206 card (10de:2d04), cuda-keyring 1.1-1 sha-verified, nvidia-driver-assistant --distro debian:13 recommended the nvidia-open 610 branch, Phoenix pre-snapshot created. That run exposed the release blocker: the recommended transaction removed the shipped nvidia-detect/nvidia-legacy-check/nvidia-installer-cleanup, which --no-remove correctly refused (surfaced as the set-u tmpdir crash, also fixed). Fix half (this ISO): helpers no longer shipped; apt-get -s install nvidia-open in the rel4 guest is REMOVAL-FREE (0 Remv, 52 Inst incl. nvidia-open + nvidia-kernel-open-dkms), so the --no-remove guard accepts and the flagship install proceeds. Full on-hardware DKMS+nvidia-smi re-run intentionally skipped per founder decision (the card has the VFIO reset bug requiring a host reboot); transaction-plan + card-visibility evidence stands in.

cases.title: AMD and Intel Mesa paths retain hardware rendering
cases.notes: FOUNDER DECISION 2026-08-09: skip the physical AMD run and trust the Mesa path from previous editions; no Intel hardware exists. Sourced basis: dpkg extraction from both ISOs shows the Mesa/libdrm/Vulkan-loader stack version-identical between 2.1.3 and 2.1.4 (see evidence); only graphics-adjacent deltas are the retired llama.cpp Vulkan backend (sanctioned 2.1.4 removal) and glx-alternative-mesa (NVIDIA-workflow rework). Physical AMD (5700G iGPU, currently BIOS-disabled) and Intel runs are roadmap-labeled for the next release. Case demoted to non-required per founder scope ruling.

Known parity-gap on the recovered path disclosed in-log.

cases.title: Sustained CPU, memory, disk, network, model and Buzz load leaves a healthy system
cases.notes: UEFI-encrypted installed system: full A32 stress (CPU/mem/mixed-encrypted-IO/fork+socket/net/APT phases) PASS with stress_failures=0; post high-memory (4x1536M,180s) audit PASS. Concurrent Buzz gemma inference under load: attempt-1 full run 4/4 UMBRA_AI_OK; attempt-2 iters 5-6 OK. DISCLOSURES: (1) attempt-1 gate tripped on a stale pre-stress failed unit (drkonqi-coredump-processor timeout after plasmashell SIGBUS at 10:25, ~30min BEFORE stress; reset-failed then clean rerun; attempt-1 log kept as stress-attempt1-stale-drkonqi-unit.log). (2) During attempt-2 memory phase the Buzz app (9.5G RSS after ~48 requests) was SIGKILLed (no kernel-OOM/oomd/earlyoom log lines; killer unattributed); relaunched via systemd-run, model serving resumed in 20s, iters 9-10 PASS incl. after high-memory phase. OS itself never faulted: zero btrfs/kernel/OOM events all runs.

Every cycle: boot_id changed, LUKS prompt detected+unlocked (masked-input PNG), SSH recovered, system running with zero failed units, cryptsetup mapper active, correct firmware, health quick JSON fail=0, greeter PNG.
